title: LU decomposition and linear system solve
summary: Factor a square matrix as P A = L U with partial pivoting, solve triangular systems by substitution, and use them to solve A x = b.

mutants.no_pivoting: Always uses the diagonal entry as the pivot.
mutants.l_swap_missing: Does not swap the stored multipliers when it swaps two rows.
mutants.perm_not_applied: Solves with b and not with b reordered by the permutation.
mutants.back_substitution_wrong_order: Runs back substitution from the first row down.
mutants.no_singular_check: Does not check the pivot, so a singular matrix gives infinity or NaN.
